description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

RTX is an aerospace and defense company developing software applications to solve complex defense challenges. The Web/Full Stack Software Engineer I will design, code, integrate, test, and deploy data-driven systems involving back-end processing, front-end web interfaces, analytics, visualization, and DevSecOps automation.
Software engineer developing, integrating, testing, and maintaining applications across the software development lifecycle

Responsibilities:
• Work on complex technical problems and collaborate to provide innovative solutions. Requires investigation and troubleshooting skills to assess issues and develop resolutions
• Work at all phases of the SW development lifecycle, including SW/HW integration, dependent on program phase
• Assist in the derivation of system and software requirements, architectural modeling, and technical analysis
• Design, code, unit test, integrate, maintain and document software applications as part of a multi-disciplinary team
• Participate actively in software peer reviews, code inspections, and technical decision-making alongside multidisciplinary teams, including program leadership and customers
• Support program execution to ensure work products meet technical, cost, schedule, and quality baselines
• Follow established software development processes and practices to maintain software product integrity
• Work Location: Onsite at our Fullerton, CA Campus
• This position requires the eligibility to obtain a security clearance.  Except in rare circumstances, only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

Requirements:
• The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required.​  U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance
• Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), preferably Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, from an accredited institution. Degree must be obtained by start date
• Proficiency/Knowledge of Web Full Stack
• Object Oriented Design and Development
• Java development, Javascript / Typescript
• Modern web UI frameworks such as Angular, Vue.js, React, component-based architecture, Web sockets
• Reactive programming paradigms and frameworks for scalable event driven applications
• Full Stack
• Java, Python, C++, Ada, scripting
• Java UI frameworks such as SWING and JavaFX
• Red Hat Linux
• Tactical data links, radar/civilian data sources
• Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies and work effectively in a collaborative  environment

Preferred:
• Experience with DOORS, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Artifactory, Coverity, Collaborator, JIRA, GitLab
• Experience with ML Ops or Data Ops frameworks (e.g., Airflow, MLflow, Kubeflow, or similar)
• Familiarity with web application architecture and tools (e.g., REST, GraphQL, PostgreSQL MongoDB, Redis)
• Exposure to real-time systems, distributed architectures, or mission-support software (e.g., visualization dashboards, situational awareness, telemetry)
• Internship or project experience involving data pipelines, AI/ML integration, or cross-domain systems
• Previous RTX or defense-related project experience, or demonstrated interest/exposure to defense mission domains (e.g., aerospace, command-and-control, sensor systems, or intelligence applications)
• Understanding of cloud-based services (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
• Knowledge of containerization and deployment technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
